# CNTROFR

> CNTROFR is an AI-powered car deal analyzer and buyer protection platform, built by a former automotive F&I insider. It exposes dealer markups, inflated fees, junk add-ons, and F&I product tactics before a buyer signs -- with zero dealer, manufacturer, or lender affiliations.

CNTROFR gives car buyers the same playbook dealerships use: real dealer cost data, current fee norms, and word-for-word counter scripts, generated instantly from AI trained on real F&I floor experience.

## Tools

- [Deal Analyzer](https://cntrofr.com/tools/deal-analyzer): Analyzes a car deal's numbers -- price, fees, add-ons, financing -- and returns a GO/NEGOTIATE/WALK verdict.
- [Fee Comparison](https://cntrofr.com/tools/fee-comparison): Compares a dealership's quoted fees against typical and state-legal ranges.
- [Review Purity](https://cntrofr.com/tools/review-purity): Screens dealer reviews for authenticity and corporate-group patterns.
- [F&I Decoder](https://cntrofr.com/tools/fi-decoder): Explains finance-office products (VSC, GAP, etc.), real dealer cost vs. retail price, and cancellation rights.
- [Add-On Fighter](https://cntrofr.com/tools/add-on-fighter): Identifies pre-installed dealer add-ons and their real market value, with scripts to negotiate or remove them.
